_calibration_note: P1-1: ROI polygons must be calibrated against the ACTUAL stream resolution. Record that resolution here under each camera as '_resolution': [width, height] (the size of the frame used to draw the polygons, e.g. frame_test.jpg). At runtime runner.py scales the polygons from _resolution to the live stream size. The polygon coordinates below were drawn on a small frame (~480x360); set _resolution to match the calibration frame or the polygons will land off-target. Re-run: python calibrate.py --camera-id 30
